$description: Inner Spark Studio, the portfolio (innerspark.studio). Flint with the portfolio's softer body text: one step lighter than Flint's default.

$source.from: portfolio-2025 src/styles/tokens.css, checked 2026-10-24. The site already copies Flint's ramps and spacing.
$source.kept: Navy, sky accent, surfaces, radius and spacing match Flint.

swapped.body text #475569 (gray.600): 7.58:1 on white but 6.92:1 on the subtle surface (chips, badges, read-only fields, menu hover), under Flint's 7:1 text bar. Uses gray.700 #334155, the nearest step that passes everywhere. Still lighter than Flint's default text.
swapped.muted text #64748B (gray.500): 4.76:1, under 7:1. Keeps Flint's muted, gray.700, so muted and body text are the same color in this brand. Use size, weight or position for hierarchy.

$source.added: No dark mode on the live site. Dark uses Flint's dark values.
